limitations.note: The rewrite stopped counting invalid cycles, but it also replaced the original three-byte packing sequence with independent pairs, dropping the output that combines the second byte’s low nibble with the third byte.
The test expected no output on the third accepted byte, so it treated the missing second packed word as a pass.

limitations.note: The rejected cleanup command forced the test launcher to be rewritten, and the subsequent Git check also had to be replaced because the workspace was not a Git repository.
